editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the CGEIT exam by ISACA. Master the governance of enterprise IT, IT resources, benefits realization, and risk optimization.
editorial.overview: The CGEIT exam thoroughly certifies qualified professionals in enterprise IT governance, managed directly by ISACA. Candidates are evaluated across four distinct domains encompassing governance, IT resources, benefits realization, and risk optimization through a total of 150 multiple choice questions administered during a standard 240-minute testing session.
editorial.who_should_take: Professionals managing, advising, or assuring enterprise IT governance frameworks. Suitable for managers and practitioners aiming to validate expertise in aligning IT with enterprise goals and optimizing resources.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official exam guide and certification page in detail well before your scheduled test date. Focus your daily preparation efforts on the four defined domains, carefully noting their respective weight percentages. Practice multiple choice questions regularly and check with ISACA for the current certification path.

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain covers the governance of enterprise IT, representing 40.0 percent of the total exam weight and establishing baseline principles for organizational leadership structures and strategic alignment.

This domain focuses directly on IT resources, accounting for 15.0 percent of the total exam weight while providing helpful insights into efficient management and operational optimization techniques for organizations.

This domain addresses benefits realization directly, making up 26.0 percent of the exam content and emphasizing value delivery alongside detailed performance measurement techniques used by qualified IT professionals.

This specific domain pertains directly to risk optimization, covering 19.0 percent of the evaluation and focusing heavily on structured risk management practices and mitigation strategies across the enterprise.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive prepared for a 240-minute linear test consisting of 150 multiple choice questions. Manage time effectively across all four domains to reach the required passing score.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official exam contains a total of 150 multiple choice questions delivered in a standard linear format designed to evaluate your professional knowledge completely across all required topics.
Candidates must achieve a scaled score of 450 out of a scale ranging from 200 to 800 to successfully pass the examination and earn the credential.
The exam has a strict total duration of 240 minutes, giving candidates ample time to answer all required questions carefully and thoughtfully during the official testing session.
The standard exam price is $760 for non-members, while active ISACA members pay a reduced preferential price of $575 when registering for the official test.

methodology.summary: This page was constructed using official ISACA documentation, certification pages, and exam guides to provide factual details on domain weights, pricing, and testing policies.
